rules.statement: The Court has discretion to alter the date fixed for deposit of preliminary survey fees prior to its expiration in an appropriate case, even under section 10(1) of the Partition Act.
rules.supporting_quote: Where, in a partition action, a date is fixed for preliminary survey fees to be deposited by the plaintiff, section 10 (1) of the Partition Act does not preclude the Court, in an appropriate case, from subsequently allowing a longer period for the deposit, provided that the alteration of the date is made prior to the expiration of the time originally fixed.
